messages:
maria-marketing: Quick sync please — we need the final changelog URL + canonical docs link for the launch post. promised APAC midday canary then wider after 2h. any blockers? :hourglass:

sam-eng: changelog draft: https://docs.redwood.inference/release/2026-03-23-changelog (stable content). Canary plan: start 11:00 PDT -> apac window 11:00-13:00 PDT, promote global at 13:00 PDT if metrics ok. i can paste rollout YAML if helpful.

maria-marketing: paste it please, want exact times for blog and support playbook. also which benchmark callout are we leading with? latency @256 tokens or cost-per-1k tokens?

sam-eng: rollout snippet below — paste into post: 
```
rollout:
  canary:
    start: "2026-03-23T11:00:00-07:00"
    regions: ["apac"]
    initial_pct: 5
    step_pct: 10
    promote_after: 2h
  global_promote: "2026-03-23T13:00:00-07:00"
```
Also use docs canonical: https://docs.redwood.inference/launch/2026-03-optimize (model profiles, quant notes).

ellie-product: i'd highlight 95th-pctl latency at 256 tokens on Dedicated (gpu-a100, int8) + the cost delta vs fp16. suggest copy: "95th pctl latency: 42ms; ~3.1x cost reduction vs fp16 baseline on identical workload." i can draft a paragraph.

maria-marketing: love it. nate — can we align webinar timing to let us show traffic ramp? want demo ~90m after global promote.

nate-growth: scheduling webinar at 14:30 PDT should work (promote @13:00 PDT). i'll wire registration, embed on post, and drip emails. who are speakers?

maria-marketing: speakers: ellie, sam, solutions eng (tbd). final list by EOD. also need inbound lead routing: high-touch enterprise leads should go straight to AE queue.

jon-sre: support webhook ready. deploy-bot: when changelog is published, webhook triggers /support/lead-route; tag "enterprise" if company_size > 200. tested with staging payload.

maria-marketing: please add webhook URL + example payload to support playbook and have Ops validate routing before publish.

jon-sre: will add in ~30m. example payload: {"lead":"ACME Corp","tier":"enterprise","source":"launch_post_2026-03-23"}

sam-eng: engineering heads-up: if marketing wants a shorter canary (faster promote), tell us by 09:30 PDT so SRE can adjust autoscale thresholds.

maria-marketing: we'll keep the window. ellie, please drop the blog intro + bench blurb in this thread — target publish 10:00 PDT.

ellie-product: drafting now, will post first pass in ~20m.

maria-marketing: final publish checklist: changelog link ✅ (sam), docs canonical ✅ (sam), benchmark blurb ✅ (ellie soon), webhook routing ✅ (jon), webinar embed + reg ✅ (nate), speaker list ✅ (maria by EOD). deploy-bot: scheduled hook?

deploy-bot: scheduled publish hook set for 2026-03-23T10:00:00-07:00. if files change after 09:30 PDT ping #release-war-room.

maria-marketing: thanks all — i'll assemble assets and post the final blog draft here for final reads. :rocket:
